mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_event (id, ts, workspace_id, actor_type, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, outcome, reason, trace_id, request_id, subject, client_ip, details_json, forwarded) VALUES (#{id}, #{ts}, #{workspaceId}, #{actorType}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{outcome}, #{reason}, #{traceId}, #{requestId}, #{subject}, #{clientIp}, #{detailsJson}, FALSE)
mapper.select: SELECT id, ts, workspace_id AS workspaceId, actor_type AS actorType, actor_id AS actorId, action, resource_type AS resourceType, resource_id AS resourceId, outcome, reason, trace_id AS traceId, request_id AS requestId, client_ip AS clientIp, details_json AS detailsJson, forwarded FROM audit_event WHERE (#{workspaceId}::varchar IS NULL OR workspace_id = #{workspaceId}) AND (#{actorId}::varchar IS NULL OR actor_id = #{actorId}) AND (#{action}::varchar IS NULL OR action = #{action}) AND (#{resourceType}::varchar IS NULL OR resource_type = #{resourceType}) AND (#{resourceId}::varchar IS NULL OR resource_id = #{resourceId}) AND (#{outcome}::varchar IS NULL OR outcome = #{outcome}) AND (#{from}::timestamptz IS NULL OR ts >= #{from}) AND (#{to}::timestamptz IS NULL OR ts <= #{to}) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, ts, workspace_id AS workspaceId, actor_type AS actorType, actor_id AS actorId, action, resource_type AS resourceType, resource_id AS resourceId, outcome, reason, trace_id AS traceId, request_id AS requestId, client_ip AS clientIp, details_json AS detailsJson, forwarded FROM audit_event WHERE forwarded = FALSE ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_event SET forwarded = TRUE WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM audit_event WHERE forwarded = TRUE AND ts < #{before}
